values.binNote: Bin's SlashBaseDamage [30/40/50/60/70] and SlashDamage (base + 0.3xad) are the TOTAL across all 4 slashes; per-slash values quoted here are that total divided by 4 (per-slash AD ratio 0.3/4=0.075), matching the wiki's per-slash row.

The base values [50/85/120/155/190] match the named ThrustBaseDamage data value inside the ThrustDamage calculation. The 0.9 AD and 0.65 AP coefficients appear only as inline literals within the XinZhaoW#ThrustDamage formula text ("+ 0.9xad + 0.65xap") and are not exposed as separate named DataValues in the sheet, so no distinct bin row can be cited for them beyond the calculation itself.

mechanics.claim: Each of the 4 slashes is a separate damage instance, causing on-hit/on-damage effects to trigger multiple times.
mechanics.quote: Each of ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' slashes are applied in a separate damage instance from each other.

mechanics.claim: The first slash happens instantly on cast, and the other 3 slashes follow every 0.05s during the first 0.15s of the cast time.
mechanics.quote: First slash happens on-cast instantly, while the remaining 3 are applied every 0.05 seconds thereafter

mechanics.claim: The thrust fires at the end of the cast time from Xin Zhao's position at that moment.
mechanics.quote: The thrust will occur from wherever '''Xin Zhao''' is at the end of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks both the slashes and the thrust; if it blocks the first (or sometimes second) slash it blocks the rest of the ability including the thrust.
mechanics.quote: If the spell shield blocks the first, or {{tt|sometimes|inconsistent}} the second slash, it will block the rest of the ability, including the thrust.

mechanics.claim: The thrust's damage is amplified by Xin Zhao's critical strike chance.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 33.3 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.33 * critical strike chance}}|critical chance}}

mechanics.claim: Xin Zhao is healed for a portion of the ability's damage based on his life steal, using the older life-steal-based healing method rather than applying life steal directly, causing Spirit Visage to amplify it twice.
mechanics.quote: Because ''Wind Becomes Lightning'' uses an older type of 'healing based on life steal' and not ''{{tip|applies life steal}}'', {{ii|Spirit Visage}} will amplify the life gain twice
